notes.title: SlimeTime Playtest v0.2 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883774/5e62860347865c0084bcca79515c26b6f753f551.png[/img][u]

[b]UI:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]Removed Debugging Trace Lines (These are for footstep sounds)
[*]Removed Debugging Print Messages (Minus a few, for Errors)
[*]Re-Designed/Cleaner UI
[*]Pause Menu (With Volume Slides)
[/list]

[u][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/u]
[i]Sewers Level[/i]

[list]
[*]New Exit Sections (Will be used for the upcoming ESCAPE game mode)
[*]Human Speed/Stamina System | Base Human walk speed is 500, 800 while sprinting.
(The Stamina regeneration and consumption values will be tweaked during testing)
[*]SexCrimer Speed Update | Base walk speed is now 600.
[/list]

[i]More Updates to come![/i]

Slime On!

-ib
